analysis: Seattle still grades out as one of the widest gaps on the board -- Elo favors the Seahawks by 254 points over a bottom-tier Chargers team, and the model projects a 12.1-point margin against a market already at -6.5/-7.5. Fresh outs on both sides (Dalvin Tomlinson for the Chargers, Zach Charbonnet for Seattle) are minor role-player losses that do not change the picture.

The public and the money are already overwhelmingly on Seattle (96% bets/handle per the latest split), so this is confirmation of a well-known story, not a contrarian edge -- most of the value in -6.5 has likely already been bet into the number.
